items.word: Turn the knob counterclockwise to open it.
items.definition:
counterclockwise
in the opposite direction to the movement of the hands of a clock

items.word: The team worked cooperatively to finish the project on time.
items.definition:
cooperatively
In a way that involves cooperation

items.word: He clumsily dropped the stack of plates.
items.definition:
clumsily
in an awkward or careless way

items.word: He decided to go to the party after all.
items.definition:
after all
in spite of everything; despite what has been said or expected

items.word: She eats healthily and exercises regularly.
items.definition:
healthily
in a way that promotes good health

items.word: He spent his time usefully studying for the exam.
items.definition:
usefully
in a way that is helpful or beneficial

items.word: The bees were busily collecting nectar from the flowers.
items.definition:
busily
In a busy manner; actively.
